items.title: Joint statement on critical PHP vulnerabilities
items.summary: ENISA issued a joint statement on the critical PHP vulnerabilities, signalling EU-level coordination on patching.

items.title: China-Linked Hackers Use ARTEX AI Agents in ConnectWise Supply Chain Attack
items.summary: Microsoft attributes the ConnectWise Cloud Backup supply chain compromise to China state-aligned Storm-0940, which used the Go-based agentic AI pentest framework ARTEX to accelerate scanning and attacks.

items.title: Cloudflare sees millions of exploit attempts after PHP disclosure
items.summary: Cloudflare reports millions of exploit attempts against the newly disclosed PHP vulnerabilities.

items.title: Hackers Exploited the PHP Vulnerabilities Days Before They Were Patched
items.summary: AWS logged attempts to exploit the PHP2Shell bugs four days before public disclosure; the flaws are now described as broadly exploited across the internet.

items.title: Microsoft pins ConnectWise supply-chain attack to China-state aligned threat group
items.summary: Microsoft says Storm-0940 used the ARTEX agentic AI pentest framework in the ConnectWise supply-chain attack, reaching over 2,250 tenants at 2,900 sign-in attempts per minute.

items.title: Critical PHP Vulnerability (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) [infocon yellow], (Wed, Oct 21st)
items.summary: SANS ISC raised InfoCon to yellow over critical PHP flaws CVE-2026-109618/109619 (CVSS 9.4 expected) given PHP's ubiquity and pre-patch PoC availability.

items.title: Compromised eMudhra intermediate certificates
items.summary: Cisco Talos reports eight compromised intermediate certificates belonging to certificate authority eMudhra, with trust-store implications.

items.title: 'PHP2Shell' Bugs Signal Red Alert for Security Industry
items.summary: Security teams are racing to remediate two critical PHP flaws dubbed PHP2Shell following leaked details and reported exploitation attempts.

items.title: Critical GitLab Flaw (CVSS 10.0) Could Allow Unauthenticated RCE Across 12 Years of Releases
items.summary: GitLab patched a CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated RCE affecting self-managed versions back to 7.0; admins who patched on 12 October must update again as fixed versions sit one patch higher.

items.title: Today's PHP Security Release, and How We're Strengthening PHP Security
items.summary: The PHP Foundation explains that CVE IDs leaked on forums on 20 October with wrong timing and CVSS data, enabling exploits before patches; all PHP 8.x users should upgrade immediately.

items.title: AI-driven, large-scale nation-state campaign using ARTEX enables supply chain compromise
items.summary: Microsoft details how Storm-0940 used ARTEX agentic AI to accelerate the ConnectWise supply chain compromise and abuse application credentials across Microsoft 365 tenants.

items.title: Threat Brief: Critical Vulnerabilities in PHP: CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619
items.summary: Unit 42 threat brief on the critical PHP vulnerabilities CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 affecting web servers and CMS deployments globally.

items.title: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619: Critical Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in PHP
items.summary: Rapid7 details CVE-2026-109618 (OOM memory corruption) and CVE-2026-109619 (use-after-free via stale global state), both CVSSv4 9.2 and enabling unauthenticated RCE on any PHP install serving web requests.

items.title: Kritische Sicherheitslücken in PHP - Updates verfügbar
items.summary: CERT.at advisory on the two critical PHP RCEs, affecting PHP-FPM, mod_php, php-cgi, FrankenPHP and LiteSpeed; updates are available.

items.title: Critical Vulnerabilities in PHP Require Immediate Patching
items.summary: CISA urges immediate patching of the 'php2shell' flaws CVE-2026-109618/109619, recommending upgrades to PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35.

items.title: eMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise
items.summary: Private keys of eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates were compromised; they chain to roots trusted by Mozilla, Microsoft, Apple and Chrome, requiring trust-store and ca-certificates updates.

items.title: Eredeti Siemens programmal töltöttek be kártékony DLL-eket a támadók A Siemens megerősítette, hogy támadók aktívan kihasználják a Siemens Software Center CVE-2026-110936 azonosítójú sérülékenységét.…
items.summary: Siemens confirms active exploitation of CVE-2026-110936 in Siemens Software Center, where attackers abuse the legitimate program to side-load malicious DLLs.

items.title: Governments working to identify exposure after global cyber-security warning
items.summary: Governments and companies are assessing exposure after a global cyber-security warning; Amazon reports it observed exploitation attempts before public disclosure.

items.title: AI agent permissions are outrunning security
items.summary: Survey of 1,100 IT and security decision-makers finds 70% now let AI agents act without human approval, and three in four organisations saw at least one AI-related security issue in the past year.

items.title: Say a few words, and a rigged AI asks for $5,000
items.summary: Imperial College London researchers backdoored speech-to-text models so one targeted speaker triggers attacker-chosen output; in a sandbox test an AI agent executed a $5,000 transfer.

items.title: Japan's Onamae Desktop Cloud hacked, up to 27,000 servers affected
items.summary: Attackers compromised Japanese VPS provider Onamae Desktop Cloud and deployed malware on up to 26,739 customer servers.

items.title: Chinese-linked hackers compromise ConnectWise, target hundreds in global attack, Microsoft says
items.summary: Reuters reports Microsoft's finding that Chinese-linked hackers compromised ConnectWise and targeted hundreds of organisations globally.

items.title: “Next Exploit Opportunities”: How a Threat Actor Used AI to Help Plan and Execute Multiple Types of Cybercrime Activities
items.summary: Unit 42 investigates a threat actor bypassing AI safety controls to plan and execute credential theft, VoIP fraud and database exfiltration.

items.title: AI Guardrails Aren’t Stopping Criminal Hackers
items.summary: Report that criminal hackers worldwide are adopting agentic AI and manipulating assistants such as Claude to support attacks despite guardrails.

items.title: Critical security issue affecting PHP
items.summary: The UK NCSC urges organisations to take immediate action on the PHP vulnerabilities CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619.

items.title: Multiples vulnérabilités dans PHP (21 octobre 2026)
items.summary: CERT-FR advisory on multiple PHP vulnerabilities allowing remote arbitrary code execution.

items.title: [Màj] Multiples vulnérabilités dans PHP (21 octobre 2026)
items.summary: Updated CERT-FR advisory confirms patches are available for PHP CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, which allow remote code execution.

items.title: Világszerte kiesett a Revolut, a háttérben a Google felhőszolgáltatásának zavara állt Kedden reggel széles körű üzemzavar sújtotta a Revolut nevű fintech céget. Az alkalmazás, a mobilbanki szolgáltat…
items.summary: Revolut suffered a global outage on Tuesday morning affecting app and mobile banking services, reportedly caused by a Google cloud service disruption.

items.title: AI security incidents accelerate global regulatory response
items.summary: IAPP analysis argues recent AI security incidents are accelerating regulatory responses worldwide.

items.title: AI agent observability is struggling to keep up with hallucinations
items.summary: Splunk survey of 2,050 professionals finds 62% frequently use AI agents for root-cause analysis, while over half cannot measure whether the agents are correct.

items.title: PHP blames supply chain security biz Chainguard for putting huge chunks of the web at risk
items.summary: The PHP project blames supply chain security vendor Chainguard for a disclosure leak that exposed large parts of the web; Chainguard's CEO defends its handling.

items.title: TiDB Breach Exposes Flawed Cloud Security Assumptions
items.summary: The TiDB breach shows cloud providers may hold sensitive customer data neither side is aware of, undermining shared-responsibility assumptions.

items.title: Cloud Security Alliance Survey Finds Data Loss Prevention Often Detects Data Loss Only After It Happens
items.summary: Cloud Security Alliance research finds only 16% of organisations experiencing data loss said DLP blocked their most significant incident before data left.

items.title: Tageszusammenfassung - 21.10.2026
items.summary: CERT.at daily summary notes Lenovo tablets shipped with a known Android Verified Boot test key and Kaspersky's analysis of Lazarus 'Operation FlashHole' watering-hole attacks.

items.title: A Design Flaw in Share Links Exposes Users’ Personal Conversations With Meta’s Muse
items.summary: A design flaw in share links exposed personal conversations with Meta's Muse assistant; the feature has been suspended after researchers' findings.

items.title: Patch the Planet: global response coordination as agents uncover critical vulnerabilities
items.summary: OpenAI describes 'Patch the Planet', an initiative connecting researchers, maintainers and responders to handle critical open-source vulnerabilities found by AI agents.

items.title: Multiples vulnérabilités dans les produits Mozilla (21 octobre 2026)
items.summary: CERT-FR reports multiple Mozilla product vulnerabilities enabling arbitrary code execution, data disclosure and denial of service.

items.title: Multiples vulnérabilités dans les produits StormShield (21 octobre 2026)
items.summary: CERT-FR advisory on multiple Stormshield product vulnerabilities enabling code execution, remote DoS and data disclosure.

items.title: Multiples vulnérabilités dans Google Chrome (21 octobre 2026)
items.summary: CERT-FR reports multiple Google Chrome vulnerabilities with unspecified security impact; updates are available.

items.title: Navigating the ghosts in the machine: Liability, governance lessons from recent AI hallucination cases
items.summary: IAPP piece reviews liability and governance lessons from recent court cases involving AI hallucinations.

items.title: UAE Transitions 50% of Gov't Services to Agentic AI
items.summary: The UAE says it has moved 50% of government services to agentic AI, claiming a security and safety foundation for the transition.

items.title: AI coding boom exposes cracks in cloud development
items.summary: LocalStack report finds 65% of teams generate at least twice as much code since adopting AI, increasing bugs, testing delays and disruptions in shared cloud environments.

items.title: Who speaks for Europe in the Ukraine peace talks?
items.summary: Politico examines internal EU tensions over who represents Europe in renewed US-pushed Ukraine-Russia peace talks.

items.title: US embassy accuses Canada of election meddling ahead of midterms
items.summary: The US embassy accuses Canada of election meddling ahead of the midterms; PM Carney rejects the claim.

items.title: DeepSeek wrapping up $15 billion fundraising to fuel AI race
items.summary: DeepSeek is reportedly finalising a $15 billion fundraising round to compete in the AI race.

items.title: Taiwan probes organised crime links to China's 'transnational repression'
items.summary: Taiwan investigates links between organised crime groups and China's alleged transnational repression activities.

items.title: Trump’s diesel deal derailed Ukraine-Russia peace progress, says Czech president
items.summary: Czech President Pavel says a US diesel deal with Russia has set back Ukraine peace progress by giving Moscow new hope.

items.title: Qatar, France call for opening of Hormuz and Gaza ceasefire implementation
items.summary: Qatar and France call for reopening the Strait of Hormuz to navigation and implementing the Gaza ceasefire.

items.title: US orders some diplomats to leave Saudi Arabia as Houthi attacks escalate
items.summary: The US ordered some diplomats to leave Saudi Arabia as Houthi attacks escalate, with deaths reported at an airport and an oil field.

items.title: Meta on the spot for $25 billion under New Mexico privacy ruling
items.summary: A New Mexico privacy ruling exposes Meta to up to $25 billion in liability tied to the Cambridge Analytica scandal.

items.title: Talking to Putin: Europe seeks a negotiator-in-chief for Ukraine
items.summary: European officials debate who should directly negotiate with Putin on Ukraine, highlighting EU coordination gaps.

items.title: Tech trio launches $10 million initiative to help under-resourced utilities bolster cybersecurity
items.summary: A $10 million private-sector initiative will help up to 500 under-resourced utilities improve their cybersecurity.

items.title: Russia ready for 3-way talks on Ukraine war, Kremlin says
items.summary: The Kremlin says Russia is ready for three-way talks on Ukraine, with Putin's aide claiming the conflict is nearing its end.

items.title: This Startup Is All In on Recursive Self-Improvement. Its Latest Model Is Scary Good
items.summary: Feature on a startup pursuing recursive self-improvement in AI models and its claimed risk-benefit tradeoff.

items.title: Europe Wants Data Centers. Its Climate Goals Are Getting in the Way
items.summary: Report on tension between European data centre expansion and climate goals, including a failed German waste-heat reuse plan.
